mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO trip ( content_id, name, region_code, category, sido, sigungu, content_type_id, lat, lon, full_address, image_url, detail_image_url, tel, homepage, description ) VALUES ( #{contentId}, #{name}, #{regionCode}, #{category}, #{sido}, #{sigungu}, #{contentTypeId}, #{lat}, #{lon}, #{fullAddress}, #{imageUrl}, #{detailImageUrl}, #{tel}, #{homepage}, #{description} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM trip ORDER BY trip_id DESC
SELECT * FROM trip ORDER BY trip_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT trip_id AS tripId, name, category, full_address AS fullAddress, description, image_url AS imageUrl, detail_image_url AS detailImageUrl, tel, homepage, lat, lon FROM trip WHERE trip_id = #{tripId}
SELECT trip_id AS tripId, name, image_url AS imageUrl, region_id AS regionId, sido, sigungu FROM trip WHERE region_id = #{regionId}
